players.product: optical components for transceivers & CPO (FAU, lens assemblies, isolators)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record; board secretary and deputy general manager Chen Kairong): the export-control policies published so far place no restrictions on optical device products and do not affect the company's business; its US-market sales share is low, with North America about 1.28% of 2025 revenue. Orders on hand and customer demand remain strong overall, and it will expand capacity globally in line with market demand and customers' project pace. It is optimistic about long-term growth in optical interconnect, especially CPO and NPO.

Management (IR record; board secretary and deputy general manager Chen Kairong): the passive optical device business keeps running at high capacity utilisation, while active-device utilisation is gradually rising as supply of key materials increases. The bottleneck-material shortage in H1 2026 constrained capacity release and delivery pace and hurt active-device growth; that tightness has clearly eased.
